visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a light blue blazer and white trousers stands on the right, gesturing toward three young women standing to his left. The women wear matching white and maroon athletic-style outfits with 'Rakuten' branding and white mini-skirts; they hold pink microphones. They are positioned in an indoor event hall with a large purple digital screen behind them featuring the text 'LEO INTERNATIONAL' and promotional graphics. The lighting is bright and warm with purple overhead accents. (2) The group remains in place as the women raise their hands to wave and then perform finger-heart gestures toward the camera. Their facial expressions are consistently joyful with wide smiles. The background screen remains static, and the camera maintains a fixed medium-full shot perspective on the four individuals throughout the sequence.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks with a moderate pitch and professional, friendly tone, introducing a date. His voice exhibits natural room reverb. Simultaneously, a low-volume electronic pop BGM with a steady 4/4 kick drum pattern plays in the background. (2) Three female voices join in synchronously, speaking with a very high pitch and bright, excited inflection to deliver a festive greeting. The combined vocal intensity increases significantly. The BGM remains constant at a low level. (3) The phase ends with the females letting out a high-pitched 'Yeah!' cheer, immediately followed by the acoustic sound of several people clapping with moderate percussiveness and spectral brightness.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a celebratory greeting for International Women's Day (March 8th). It features a male host and members of the Rakuten Girls (cheerleaders) to promote a 'Fashion & Beauty Night' event. The goal is to encourage female viewers to love and care for themselves while promoting the host organization.
